info.title: PodNest API
info.description:
REST API for the PodNest admin panel. Every endpoint requires an authenticated session (cookie) with appropriate role. Path parameter `{id}` is the site ID except under the Users tag, where it is the user ID.

**Note:** request/response schemas are being documented incrementally; endpoints not yet enriched show a generic body.

tags.name: Sites
tags.description: Site CRUD, lifecycle (start/stop/restart/recreate), clone, and image pruning.

tags.name: Backups
tags.description: Per-site backup create/list/restore/download and import (SFTP/upload).

tags.name: Basic Auth
tags.description: Per-site HTTP basic-auth realm and user management.

tags.name: Cron
tags.description: Per-site cron job CRUD, toggle, and run-now.

tags.name: Domains
tags.description: Per-site domain attach/detach and listing.

tags.name: File Manager
tags.description: Per-site file manager: list, read, write, upload, download, copy, move, chmod, mkdir, delete.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: User CRUD and per-user TOTP enrollment.

tags.name: Audit Log
tags.description: Admin-only audit log read endpoint.

tags.name: Logs
tags.description: Global and per-site proxy/WAF/container log streaming.

tags.name: Security
tags.description: Global IP/UA rules, security bypass list, and import/export.

tags.name: Settings
tags.description: Global settings: resources, backup, notifications, trusted proxies, WAF, import/export.

tags.name: WAF
tags.description: Per-site WAF toggles, exclusions, CRS plugins, and import/export.

tags.name: Configs
tags.description: Per-site service config (nginx/php/etc.) read, write, reset, import/export.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Container health streaming and per-container restart.

tags.name: Redirects
tags.description: Per-site redirect rules with regex/capture-group support.

tags.name: Reverse Proxy
tags.description: Reverse-proxy upstream route management for type-6 sites.

tags.name: Stats
tags.description: Global and per-site traffic, pod, disk, and drilldown statistics.

tags.name: WP-CLI
tags.description: WP-CLI command execution against a site.

tags.name: SSL
tags.description: Panel SSL certificate status.

tags.name: phpMyAdmin
tags.description: Single-use phpMyAdmin SSO token minting.

tags.name: SFTP
tags.description: Per-site SFTP credential regeneration.

200.description: Success — may return {"status": "confirm", "reason": "..."} when the rule set would block the requesting connection; resend with "confirm": true to force
